title: THE WORLD WOKE TO ONE STORY
subtitle: Front pages, 10 November 1989.
source: Library of Congress, Chronicling America (sample crops pending)

headlines.headlineText: EAST GERMANY OPENS FRONTIER TO THE WEST FOR MIGRATION OR VISITS
headlines.deck: Border posts removed; thousands cross to West Berlin and West Germany overnight.
Three decades of Cold War division end as East German citizens stream into the West.
À Berlin, les frontières s'effacent dans la nuit.
Berliner umarmen sich an den Grenzübergängen.
